note: The levers the B14 learner (tools/b14_rl.py) may try -- Desire 16 Oct 2026. Each lever is one setting of the new B14 rules (b14_rules.TUNABLE, or one number of the ladder). 'exit' levers re-run only the exits of the same trades (fast, every week); 'entry' levers re-run the whole replay (slow, a few per week, picked by the learner). 'step' is how far one try moves the value; 'min'/'max' bound every try. To let the learner try a new lever, add it here -- the learner itself never changes the bot.
